name: asyntai-ai-chatbot
title: Asyntai AI Chatbot
description: Your Asyntai AI chat agent answers website visitors. When it opens a support ticket, that ticket appears in your YouTrack helpdesk with the whole conversation.
changeNotes: 1.1.0: Asyntai is called after the request returns, with the async HTTP calls of YouTrack 2026.2, so no request thread waits on the AI. Needs YouTrack 2026.2 or later. 1.0.1: replies and chat messages render their formatting (bold, lists, links); dates follow the YouTrack language. 1.0.0: a reply drafted by your Asyntai AI agent on every ticket, and the earlier website chats of the reporter.

widgets.name: Asyntai
widgets.description: The website chats of the person who reported this ticket, and a reply drafted by your AI agent.
